blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers has warned against the possibility that China will suddenly play negotiator when member-states convene for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit, saying that the nation’s questionable actions must be considered. Barbers in a statement on Thursday urged Philippine authorities to be wary of the possible “double-talk” from China, noting that it cannot be a good negotiator if it cannot even peacefully settle differences over the West Philippine Sea (WPS).
